title: 第7章 未婚妻的选择第8章 追求者的报复
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
“好，我们马上来。”
叶雅见小儿子伤势全好了，一副生龙活虎的模样，心情大好，想起大儿子的婚姻大事，当即答应。
李凡调笑道：“哥，嫂子知道你回来了，第一时间来看你了。”
从小到大，他都是这样没心没肺，单纯真诚，看到最亲的人归来后，浑然忘了不久前被李天打断手脚，废掉经脉的痛苦，笑容很纯真。
叶雅提醒道：“小凡，别乱说，你哥和清雪小姐还没订婚呢。”
“娘，小弟，我们一起去看看。”
李易带着锈迹斑斑的天剑，与叶雅，李凡走出房间。
“小凡，你好了？”
二长老李长苏看到换好衣衫的李凡，朝气蓬勃，惊得目瞪口呆，脸上满是震撼，那么重伤势，能在这么短时间治好，除非是服用道丹，甚至是帝丹才能做到。
李凡高兴笑道：“我哥给我治好的。”
“我在外面游历时，获得了一颗神奇丹药，给小凡服下后，他就恢复了。”
李易知道天璇女帝不喜别人知道她的存在，自然不会说李凡是她治疗好的。
“哈哈，小凡运气好啊，有你这样的大哥。”
李长苏开朗一笑，紧接着面色严肃道：“丹药之事别透露出去，有人问起就说是小凡体质特殊，再加上叶雅的医术高明才康复的。”
“明白。”
叶雅和李凡点头。
一行四人很快便来到了李族的会客大厅，这里聚集了一大群人。
最上面的主位坐着一名身穿蓝袍的中年人，外形儒雅俊朗，给人一种不怒自威的威压。
旁边坐着族长李长青和其他三位族长。
下方坐着族中的长老和一群陌生的年轻男女，其中最为瞩目是一名身穿浅绿色长裙的女子，她五官精致绝美，身材凹凸有致，肌肤如雪，像是一个精灵，美得让人沉醉。

最让人惊叹的是她那清冷而高贵的气质，仿佛世间一切事物在她面前都黯然失色。
李易与天璇，玉衡，摇光三位女帝一起生活三年，也算是见过人间绝色的人，但看到这名美丽绝伦的女子，依然感到十分惊艳。
论容貌，身材，气质，她也就比三大女帝稍微弱一点。
但她还小啊，假以时日，未必不能赶上三大女帝。
而她就是李易的未婚妻林清雪，天圣学院当代首席，燕国赫赫有名的天骄。
“李易，快来向你林伯伯问好。”
李长青看到李易一家人赶到，赶紧站起来招呼。
“林伯伯。”
李易和李凡同时行了一礼，叶雅也微笑着打了一个招呼。
林峰看向李易，淡淡道：“正主来了，那我就长话短说吧。”
李长青和家族众长老，包括叶雅，心中一紧，李易的龙骨消失，修为暴跌，不知道会不会影响他与林清雪的婚约，毕竟对方现在可是天圣学院的首席，乃年轻一辈的翘楚，追求者无数，其中就有不朽皇朝和上古世家的天骄。
随着林清雪一起来的青年才俊面露笑容，他们都是元府境，乃至万法境的修士，一眼就看出了李易当前的修为。
这样的人，如何能配得上如天仙的林清雪。
“林伯伯，你说。”
李易神色平静，自己消失了三年，像林清雪这样杰出又漂亮的天才少女，肯定会有许多皇子，世子追求，她若移情别恋，也在情理之中。
他已经大致猜到了结果，无非就是退婚。
content_en:
"Okay, we'll come right away."
Ye Ya was in a good mood when she saw that her younger son was completely healed from his injuries and was looking lively and energetic. Thinking of her eldest son's marriage, she immediately agreed.
Li Fan teased: "Brother, my sister-in-law came to see you as soon as she knew you were back."
Ever since he was a child, he has been so heartless, simple and sincere. After seeing his closest relatives return, he completely forgot about the pain of having his hands and feet broken and his meridians disabled by Li Tian not long ago, and his smile was pure.
Ye Ya reminded: "Xiao Fan, don't talk nonsense, your brother and Miss Qingxue are not engaged yet."
"Mom, little brother, let's go take a look together."
Li Yi took the rusty Heavenly Sword and walked out of the room with Ye Ya and Li Fan.
"Xiaofan, are you okay?"
The second elder, Li Changsu, saw Li Fan changing his clothes. He was full of energy and was stunned. His face was full of shock. Such a serious injury could be cured in such a short time only by taking Dao Dan or even Emperor Dan.
Li Fan smiled happily and said, "My brother cured it for me."
"When I was traveling outside, I obtained a magical elixir. After giving it to Xiaofan, he recovered."
Li Yi knew that Empress Tianxuan didn't like others to know her existence, so naturally she wouldn't say that Li Fan was cured by her.
"Haha, Xiaofan is so lucky to have a big brother like you."
Li Changsu smiled cheerfully, and then said with a serious face: "Don't reveal the matter about the elixir. If anyone asks, just say that it was Xiaofan's special constitution and Ye Ya's superb medical skills that made him recover."
"Understood."
Ye Ya and Li Fan nodded.
The group of four people soon arrived at the Li family's reception hall, where a large group of people gathered.
Sitting on the top seat was a middle-aged man wearing a blue robe. His appearance was elegant and handsome, giving people a sense of calm and authority.
Sitting next to them were clan leader Li Changqing and three other clan leaders.
Sitting below were the elders of the clan and a group of strange young men and women. Among them, the most eye-catching one was a woman wearing a light green dress. She had delicate and beautiful features, a curvy figure, and skin as white as snow. She was like an elf, so beautiful that people were intoxicated.
The most amazing thing is her cold and noble temperament, as if everything in the world pales in front of her.
Li Yi has lived with the three empresses Tianxuan, Yuheng, and Yaoguang for three years. He has seen some stunning people in the world, but he was still very surprised when he saw this stunningly beautiful woman.
In terms of appearance, figure, and temperament, she is slightly weaker than the three empresses.
But she is still young, and given time, she may not be able to catch up with the three empresses.
And she is Li Yi's fiancée Lin Qingxue, the contemporary chief of Tiansheng Academy, and a famous genius in the Yan Kingdom.
"Li Yi, come and say hello to your Uncle Lin."
Li Changqing saw Li Yi and his family arriving and quickly stood up to greet them.
"Uncle Lin."
Li Yi and Li Fan saluted at the same time, and Ye Ya also said hello with a smile.
Lin Feng looked at Li Yi and said calmly: "The rightful owner is here, so I'll keep the story short."
Li Changqing and the elders of the family, including Ye Ya, felt nervous. Li Yi's bones disappeared and his cultivation level plummeted. It was not known whether it would affect his engagement with Lin Qingxue. After all, the other party was now the chief of Tiansheng Academy and a leader of the younger generation. He had countless suitors, including the geniuses of the Immortal Dynasty and ancient families.
The young talents who came with Lin Qingxue smiled. They were all monks in Yuanfu Realm and even Wanfa Realm. They could tell Li Yi's current cultivation level at a glance.
How could such a person be worthy of the immortal Lin Qingxue.
"Uncle Lin, tell me."
Li Yi looked calm. He had disappeared for three years. An outstanding and beautiful talented girl like Lin Qingxue would definitely be pursued by many princes and princes. It would be reasonable for her to fall in love with someone else.
He had already roughly guessed the outcome, which was nothing more than breaking off the engagement.
